get.description:
Read only this token subject's profile; uninitialized fields are null.

No row is inserted and no session expiration writes occur on this GET.
Phone identity is managed by Auth0, never supplied through this API.

413.description: Request exceeds 1 MiB or decoded picture exceeds 512 KiB.

put.description:
Atomically replace display name and picture for the validated token subject.

Both fields are required; null explicitly removes the picture. No phone,
owner ID, URL or onboarding policy fields are accepted. Name is a strict
string, Unicode-whitespace trimmed, 1..80 codepoints; controls/surrogates
are rejected. Picture is strict canonical base64 of JPEG/PNG, <=512 KiB,
<=2048 per side and <=4,194,304 pixels, not animated or truncated, matching
its declared MIME type. Output is metadata-free JPEG with EXIF orientation
applied, alpha flattened on white, longest edge <=512 (never upscaled).
Retries replace one row; created_at is preserved, updated_at is server UTC.
The request body is bounded to 1 MiB even without Content-Length.

413.description: Request exceeds 1 MiB or decoded picture exceeds 512 KiB.

post.description:
Store a client-reported completed game, owned only by the validated subject.

Server awards 10 participation points per unique UUID under completion_v1,
independent of score or outcome. This is not verified gameplay or anti-cheat.
Every field is required; extra owner/points/phone fields are rejected.
Identical canonical replay returns the original result/timestamp (200).
Changed accepted fields return 409; another owner's UUID returns 404.
Body is bounded to 32768 bytes, even when Content-Length is missing/false.
No profile, reading history, device, session, or mutable points total is changed.

413.description: Request exceeds 32768 bytes or canonical data exceeds 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

get.description: Private read-only ledger, ordered by created_at DESC, result_id DESC.

413.description: Request exceeds 32768 bytes or canonical data exceeds 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

get.description:
Read-only points/counts derived from the immutable owner ledger.

Unplayed users receive zero totals and an empty per_game array. Per-game
aggregates are ordered by game_id ASC; best_score is MAX of raw score.
No parties count, public leaderboard or verified gameplay claims.

413.description: Request exceeds 32768 bytes or canonical data exceeds 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

data.title: Data
data.description: Strict JSON object, canonical sorted-key compact ensure_ascii=False serialization <=4096 UTF-8 bytes; <=128 value nodes including root (depth 0), maximum depth 4; object keys 1..64 codepoints, lists <=64 items, strings <=512 codepoints; finite numbers with absolute value <=1e12. Invalid tree: 422; encoded size overflow: 413.

UserAccessToken.description: Auth0 RS256 user-delegated API access token (not an ID/M2M token).

DeviceCredential.description: Privately provisioned per-device credential; never a user JWT.
